 Agreed Compliance Measures
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by public office holders and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist them in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holders and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends.
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity to further my private interests or to improperly further the private interests of Rio Tinto, its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, Rio Tinto Group), or to give preferential treatment to that organization, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a public office holder.
Accordingly, I have agreed to recuse myself from any discussion or decision involving the Board of Directors of Invest in Canada Hub in relation to the mining and minerals sector as a whole. I have also agreed to recuse myself from any discussion or decision relating to other investment projects or proposals in the energy sector in which Rio Tinto Group has a direct or indirect interest. For greater certainty, an indirect interest includes matters relating to partnerships, joint ventures or co-investment opportunities that involve Rio Tinto Group.
I understand that recusal means I must remove myself from the room, physically or virtually as the case may be. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter which I or the screen administrators know or reasonably should know to affect Rio Tinto Group’s private interests.
In addition, I have agreed not to lobby the Government of Canada on behalf of Rio Tinto Group, beyond the expiry of the five-year prohibition on lobbying as set out in the Lobbying Act, for the duration of my term as a public office holder.
This screen is co-administered by the Chief Executive Officer and the Chief Operating Officer of Invest in Canada to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decision-making processes involving Rio Tinto Group’s private interests. I will participate in decisions or matters of general application and those that may affect its private interests as a member of a broad class of persons unless those interests are disproportionate to the other members of the class.
The President of the King's Privy Council for Canada and the Minister responsible for Canada-U.S. Trade, Intergovernmental Affairs, Internal Trade, and One Canadian Economy, the Chief Executive Officer, and Chief Operating Officer of Invest in Canada, all other board members, colleagues and necessary public servants have been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen.
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the matters caught by this screen.
In the event that I am made aware of a matter forming part of this screen or any such matter comes before me, I am required under section 21 of the Act to recuse myself from that matter, by leaving the room or the virtual meeting where the discussion and decision making is taking place. I must so inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and, where determined appropriate by the Commissioner, make a public declaration of recusal.
